about: Check-in chat replies for check-society-suggestions.mjs. Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

gigs, rules out sport.message: Gigs and live music. Not sport. A gig, then out with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gigs, rules out sport.reply:
Since you are into gigs and live music, you might enjoy [[Music]], [[Rock]], or [[Vocaloid]]. 

You can also check out [[Gigs]] for what is coming up at the Students' Union.

homebody, rules out partying.message: Board games and reading. Not partying. A quiet night in with a film. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
homebody, rules out partying.reply: For reading, [[Book]] is a great choice, and [[Film]] is ideal for your film nights. You might also enjoy [[Chess]] for a quiet strategy game.

sporty early riser.message: Football and the gym. Up early for a run, then football. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
sporty early riser.reply: For your run, you might want to check out [[Running]] for training sessions and [[Athletics & XC]]. If you fancy getting involved in a society too, take a look at the Societies page to browse what is on offer.

lie-in and the cinema.message: Photography and the cinema. A lie-in, then the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
lie-in and the cinema.reply: Since you like films, you might enjoy [[Film]] for movie nights or [[Film & TV Production]] if you are on that course.

gamer, last minute (near tie).message: Gaming, Minecraft and FIFA. Gaming online late with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gamer, last minute (near tie).reply: For gaming, you might like the [[Gaming and Roleplay]] society. Is there anything else you would like reminding about while you settle in?

clubbing (synonyms for partying).message: Going clubbing and festivals. Big nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
clubbing (synonyms for partying).reply:
If you love big nights out, you might enjoy [[Events]] and [[Gigs]] for what is on at the Students' Union. 

Is there anything you would like reminding about while you settle in, and we can add it to your checklist?

outdoors, rules out the gym.message: Hiking and climbing. Not the gym. Up early for a long walk. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
outdoors, rules out the gym.reply: For getting outdoors and going on long walks, you might like [[Walking]], and [[Climbing]] is great if you want to try scaling walls.

unrelated to every mentor.message: Knitting and birdwatching. A trip to a nature reserve. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
unrelated to every mentor.reply: For knitting, you might like [[Stitch, Make & Bitch]] for crafting with others. We do not have a birdwatching society, but you could browse the [[Societies]] page to see all the options available.

only says what they don't want in 3 answ.message: I'm not into sport, clubbing or gaming. I don't like loud nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
only says what they don't want in 3 answ.reply: Since you'd like to steer clear of sport, clubbing and gaming, what sorts of things do you enjoy doing in your spare time?

quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.message: Reading and films. Quiet nights in, not nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.reply: For cosy nights in, you might like [[Book]] for reading groups or [[Film]] to chat about movies.

live music (synonym for gigs).message: Live music, mostly indie bands. Seeing a band, then drinks with friends. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
live music (synonym for gigs).reply: You might like [[Rock]] for finding others who are into live music and gigs. Is there anything else you would like reminding about while you settle in?

interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.message: I'm not Ukrainian, but I'd love to learn more about Ukrainian culture and meet people. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.reply: You can join [[Ukrainian]], where everyone is welcome to learn about the culture and meet people.

a mature student.message: I'm a mature student, so I'm a bit older than most people on my course. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a mature student.reply: It is great that you have joined us. For mature students, [[Mature Students]] is a wonderful way to connect with others in a similar position.

worried about money.message: I'm really worried about money. My loan won't last until the end of term and I don't know what to do.
worried about money.reply: I am really sorry to hear you are feeling stressed about money, but there is support available. You can take a look at [[Cost of Living]] for help with money worries, including access to a food pantry and laptop loans.

run out of money for food.message: I've run out of money for food this week and I'm not sure what to do.
run out of money for food.reply: I am sorry to hear you are dealing with that worry, but there is support available right here. You can check [[Cost of Living]] for help with money and food, and [[Food Pantry]] to book a parcel.

accused of plagiarism.message: I've been accused of plagiarism in one of my essays and I'm panicking.
accused of plagiarism.reply: Try to take a deep breath, as you do not have to handle this on your own. You can contact the [[Advice Centre]] for confidential help and guidance on academic misconduct cases.

landlord won't fix the damp.message: My landlord won't fix the damp in my flat and keeps ignoring my messages. Can I complain?
landlord won't fix the damp.reply: Yes, you can complain about that, and you should reach out to the [[Advice Centre]] for guidance on housing issues and how to handle landlords.

swims a lot.message: I swim a lot and I'd like to keep it up while I'm here. Any clubs or societies?
swims a lot.reply: Check out [[Swimming]] to join the university's swimming team and see their training times and membership options.

played football at school.message: I played football at school and I'd like to start playing again. Where should I look?
played football at school.reply: You can check out [[Football]] for training and matches with Northumbria Sport.

into ice hockey.message: I'm really into ice hockey. Is there anything for me here?
into ice hockey.reply: Ice Hockey is a popular choice and there is a [[Ice Hockey]] society you can join.

never done sport, wants to get fit.message: I've never really done any sport, but I want to get fitter this year. Any ideas?
never done sport, wants to get fit.reply:
If you want to get fitter, you could try [[Pilates]] or [[Yoga]] for fitness and flexibility. 

Is there anything else you would like reminding about while you settle in?

do I pay to see a doctor.message: I'm an international student. Do I have to pay to see a doctor here?
do I pay to see a doctor.reply: No, you do not have to pay to see a doctor through the NHS. Take a look at the [[NHS Guide]] for more details on how it works.

how does the NHS work.message: I've just arrived from abroad and I don't understand how the NHS works. Can you explain?
how does the NHS work.reply: The NHS is the UK national health service that provides healthcare, and seeing a doctor is free. Take a look at the [[NHS Guide]] for more information on how it all works and how to register.

how to contact a suggested society.first: I love knitting and crochet. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to contact a suggested society.firstReply: If you enjoy crochet, you might like [[Hooked By Crochet]] or [[Stitch, Make & Bitch]] for making things and meeting others who share your interests.
how to contact a suggested society.thenReply: You can find all the details and contact options by checking out [[Hooked By Crochet]] or [[Stitch, Make & Bitch]].

how to join a suggested society.first: I'm really into climbing and bouldering. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to join a suggested society.firstReply: For climbing and bouldering, you might like [[Climbing]] and [[Outdoor Climbing]]. Both fit your interests well.
how to join a suggested society.thenReply: To join, just take a look at [[Climbing]] and [[Outdoor Climbing]] for the details on how to get involved.

what a suggested society is like.first: I like board games and tabletop role-playing games. Are there any societies for that?
what a suggested society is like.firstReply: You should check out [[Gaming and Roleplay]] for tabletop role-playing and board games. Is there anything you would like reminding about while you settle in?
what a suggested society is like.thenReply: You can find out what it is like and how to join on [[Gaming and Roleplay]].

a suggested society's Instagram.first: I love films and going to the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a suggested society's Instagram.firstReply:
You might like [[Film]] to chat about all things cinema. 

Is there anything you would like reminding about while you settle in?
a suggested society's Instagram.thenReply: You can check out [[Film]] in the app to find their social media links and how to contact them.
